conversation_pain_points: bot gave generic search advice after the user explained the burden of searching

main_topics.reason: The user repeatedly asked how to identify eligible trials, find matching support, locate research-active clinics, and check US recruitment.
The user asked what new, disease-directed research exists and discussed BC 007, temelimab, and the Paxlovid trial.
The user said getting into a dedicated clinic involved a difficult waitlist and returned to the lack of a practical route into care.
The user described having tried standard POTS measures to explain that symptom management was not the information they wanted.
The user said they were tired of trying ineffective approaches and later expressed frustration that trial access still required extensive self-searching.
The user said cognitive impairment made it hard to read and compare trial listings, but raised this in one part of the discussion.
The user mentioned still being unable to work, but did not return to its effects during the conversation.

output.summary: The user wanted evidence-based new research for long COVID beyond POTS management, then focused on how to find trials they might qualify for in the US without doing extensive searching while cognitively impaired. The assistant explained search filters and suggested research-active clinics, but did not provide specific matches; the user ended with a general picture while the practical access burden remained.
